record.question: In a FLAIR sequence of the brain, the signal from which substance is intentionally suppressed to better visualize periventricular or subcortical lesions is?
record.explanation: Answer D: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). FLAIR suppresses CSF signal to make periventricular lesions more conspicuous. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
